notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.19.4 GR2: "If a source listing is being produced, a PAGE directive shall cause page ejection followed by listing of the PAGE directive." The driver records each PAGE directive it processes, and the listing starts a page before the listed PAGE line, which is then the first source row of the new page (the witness splits the text listing at its form feeds). A PAGE directive under LISTING OFF is a source line §2023:7.3.18.3 GR4 stops and GR3 does not exempt, so it is neither listed nor ejects a page (DESIGN-listing.md section 2.3). The earlier CONFORMS rested on the signed derivation DRV-GR-7.3.19.4-2 (unpopulatable-antecedent: no listing is produced, A.1 item 117); a listing is now produced on request (cobol --listing at 2002, 2014 and 2023), so the antecedent is populated and the derivation is withdrawn.
